plugins.prepareCmd: npm version ${nextRelease.version} --no-git-tag-version --allow-same-version && perl -0pi -e 's/"version": *"[^"]*"/"version": "${nextRelease.version}"/' src-tauri/tauri.conf.json && perl -0pi -e 's/^version = ".*"/version = "${nextRelease.version}"/m' src-tauri/Cargo.toml && perl -0pi -e 's/(^name = "warframe-utility"\nversion = )".*"/$1"${nextRelease.version}"/m' src-tauri/Cargo.lock
